name: Settlement reducer/replay/Runner
state: structuredClone of state per call; throws leave caller state untouched
formulation: reduce(state,cmd,config,providers)->{state,events,result}; Runner logs commands
invariants: failed command changes nothing; providers' own stores are the host's to roll back
approximations: Provider mutations (produce/take) are not rolled back on a throw after the provider call; handlers validate first
notes: Same pattern as economy.infra.reducer_replay (two copies of reduce/Runner/ctx/ids/must/finite helpers)

name: Settlement id minting
formulation: prefix.<4-digit n>; never reused
approximations: zero-padded to 4 digits
notes: Economy has a duplicate mint() with its own prefixes (inv,mkt,ship,ord,org). Pool detection is by string prefix 'pool.' hard-coded in the engine (host convention leaking into engine)

name: Settlement daily tick order
formulation: steps in order decay,projects,staffing,production,wages,publicWorks,expiry then day+=1
invariants: day increments only at end of tick
approximations: order is config
notes: settlement.day and economy.day are separate counters; contract s9 says economy.tick(N) but the economy tick command takes no day argument. Host must keep two clocks in lock-step

name: Parcel split/merge
formulation: children must be contained in parent, non-overlapping, >=2; merge needs same district and same title holder; union of rects
invariants: parent retired never reused; split refused with buildings or active leases; title chain recorded as ledger 'transfer'
approximations: merge footprint = union of Rects, no real geometry
notes: Land use (Q18) is just opaque 'zoning'; no use/soil/fertility model

name: Title sale/transfer/inherit
formulation: sell: refuse if not transferable.sale or buyer outside transferable.to; money buyer->holder via pay(kind 'sale'); transfer kinds gift/transfer/seizure (seizure needs office power 'seize'); inherit: heir supplied by host, no law of succession
invariants: one holder per title; each change one ledger row
sources: Rex via paste: not every property is purchasable (QUESTIONS Q6)
approximations: inheritance and succession law deliberately absent; sale price given explicitly (PriceProvider.valueOf not called)
notes: Sale price duplicates what economy's PriceProvider.valueOf was declared to offer; valueOf is declared but never called (CONTRACTS s12.3 open)

name: Lease and rent
formulation: rent paid each tick tenant->title holder while active; room-scoped leases must not overlap; whole lease excludes others
approximations: rent flat per day; no market rent, no arrears or eviction
notes: rent is set by host (Q10 open); economy has no rent-quote analogue. Rent is paid even if tenant balance is negative

name: Right of use
formulation: title holder OR tenant with active lease on that title
approximations: lease room scope vs business premises rooms not cross-checked

name: Offices, permits, permissions
formulation: action allowed iff office has holder and power in powers[]; permission expires when expires<=day
invariants: appointments and permits are ledger rows (amount 0)
approximations: no tax, election, succession; publicWorks tick step is an empty stub reserved for tax power
notes: Government/institution domain (E) lives here as a thin layer; economy README says duties/taxes belong to a future Government engine; PLATFORM says domain E has no owner

name: Building condition decay
formulation: condition = max(0, condition - band.decayPerDay) unless an active 'repair' project targets it; bands fine>=0.8:0.0005, sound>=0.5:0.001, poor>=0.2:0.002, ruined:0
approximations: decay depends on condition band only: no weather/material/use/maintenance labour; ruined stops decaying (decayPerDay 0) which is physically odd
tests: engine.test U7 (condition vs status); no direct decay-rate test
notes: Third decay notion beside economy.spoilage (goods) and realism decay/decomposition; all constant-rate, different rules. Magic numbers with no source

name: Condition to output factor
formulation: each fixture counts as outputFactor (fine 1, sound 0.9, poor 0.6, ruined 0)
approximations: step function by band; no source
notes: placeholder numbers, no source

name: Construction/renovation/repair/demolish projects
formulation: each tick: draw all materials all-or-nothing via MaterialProvider.have/take from inventory ref = project.account; wait for permit if required; draw min(wanted, workers) worker-days via labour.draw(pool,'labourer',ceil(wanted)); pay wage*days from account to pool; complete when progress>=labourDays
invariants: materials drawn atomically; layout version increments; money only with a ledger row
sources: none (all quantities supplied per project by host)
approximations: no lumber-per-wall, technique, tool, skill or weather model: materials list and labourDays are opaque host numbers (PLATFORM mission wants these as mechanisms). Role 'labourer' and default pool 'pool.default' hard-coded
notes: MISSING mechanism for the mission: structure/material requirements per building. Project.account is used BOTH as money holder (pay from) and as inventory ref (have/take), so the holder string must equal an inventory id, contradicting economy's Inventory(inv.*, holder) split

name: Layout persistence
formulation: renovate adds rooms/fixtures, bumps version, keeps history; setLayout only via project unless config.freeLayout
invariants: placements must reference existing fixtures and rooms

name: Business record and premises
formulation: requires right of use over each premises; account = accountOf(biz id); inventory is an opaque ref minted by economy
approximations: Business.account is an acct.* id while the ledger holder is the biz.* id (two identifiers on the money side)

name: Post resolution and business status
formulation: post.filledBy = holder if person available or pool draw>=1; business staffed iff open AND (operator or manager available) AND every required post filled; 'producing' set in production
invariants: status is derived, never set by host
sources: Rex (Q2: business runs if manager available)
approximations: binary staffing: any unfilled required post = dormant; pool post draws 1 worker per day
notes: Staffing here vs economy.labour.wage_quote: settlement fills posts with no wage competition, hiring or quitting; economy quote has no path back. Q10 (post counts, wages) open

name: LabourProvider interface (settlement)
formulation: available(person,day); draw(pool,role,requires,wanted,day)->number; productivity(holder,role)
sources: CONTRACTS s4a (Economy does not implement it)
approximations: interface only; no skill/age/health model; stubs only
notes: contract.labour_provider: implemented by host/realism POPULATION (not built); consumed by settlement. TWO host interfaces for one concept: this draw() and economy LabourSupplyProvider.supply(market,role,day). Neither implemented

name: Production capacity Q = min(...)

outputs.name: Q units per line per day

formulation: per line: Q=max(0,floor(min(Q_equip,Q_labour,Q_mat,Q_util))); lines run in order; each produced line spends labourPerUnit*Q of the day's shared labour-days
invariants: Q integer, never exceeds available; labour not double counted
approximations: Leontief minimum; no learning, quality, tool wear, variance, seasons; fixtures not consumed; lines share labour in order (Q15 open)
notes: Stock-creation path 1 of 3 (with economy.production.abstract_market and host addStock); output goes via MaterialProvider.produce into economy's inventory

name: Equipment cap Q_equipment
formulation: min over needed fixture kinds of (count of fixture across premises * outputFactor) * unitsPerFixtureDay; no equipment => Infinity
approximations: output proportional to fixture count; no shifts, no one fixture shared by several lines
notes: ProductionLine.equipment (settlement) duplicates Recipe.equipment (economy); host copies at openBusiness/setLines (CONTRACTS s2)

name: Labour cap Q_labour
formulation: labourDays = sum over filled posts (hours/hoursPerDay)*productivity; cap = labourDays/labourPerUnit (Infinity if 0)
approximations: hoursPerDay=10 placeholder; post wage is per day regardless of hours (hours only scales labour); productivity unitless from host
notes: Only place a time unit in hours appears (hours/day); economy wage_quote ignores post.hours

name: UtilityProvider (heat/power/water capacity)
formulation: capacity(building,recipe,state)->number; engine takes min across premises; stub = Infinity
sources: none (listed in PACKAGES s4, not in CONTRACTS)
approximations: no real implementation; realism not wired; min across premises where sum might be expected
notes: Declared, always Infinity today. contract.utility_provider: to be implemented by realism, consumed by settlement. Not in CONTRACTS.md

name: Wage payments
formulation: each tick every filled post with wage>0: pay(payer->filledBy, wage, 'wage', post id); payer = business id, or treasury holder if publicWorks
invariants: money conserved; balances may go negative
approximations: wage fixed by host (no labour market in settlement); paid whether or not the business produced and even if another required post is unfilled; payer may run unlimited debt; hours do not scale pay
notes: OVERLAP: fixed post wage (settlement) vs market wage quote (economy, never applied). Project wages paid separately in tick/projects.ts, same kind 'wage' but subject = project id

name: setWage command
formulation: assign wage
approximations: the only route for an economy wage quote to reach a post is the host calling this
notes: Blocked by Q10 and contract s12.6: whether a quote may move Post.wage

name: Ledger and accounts
home: Toolchain/settlement/src/context.ts pay/record/accountOf; commands.ts credit/debit/payCommand; queries.ts ledger/balanceOf/totalMoney
formulation: payer.balance -= amount; payee.balance += amount; one Transaction row; accounts created lazily per holder
invariants: total money conserved except explicit credit/debit; negative balances allowed; every change one row
approximations: no interest, currency or money-supply rule; credit/debit commands create/destroy money outside conservation
notes: This is the single money home per CONTRACTS s3; economy has only a StubLedger. Open: Q7 port.cash=treasury

name: Lease and permission expiry
formulation: if end<=day => endLease; permission => 'expired'

name: hasFixture / physical / economic readings
formulation: hasFixture: any standing building holds fixture; activeOnly requires a non-dormant business in it
notes: economy src never calls reader.hasFixture/businesses/production; equipment-presence check promised in CONTRACTS s6 is not built

name: Assignments, hire, dismiss
formulation: non-exclusive residence/employment/management/membership; hire sets post.holder; dismiss clears
invariants: assignments never end on their own
notes: Residence/membership live here; household/kinship (domain F) has no owner

name: Economy reducer/replay/Runner
formulation: reduce(state,cmd,config,providers); Runner.replay(log)
invariants: failed command leaves state unchanged; replay byte-identical
notes: Copy of settlement reducer pattern

name: Economy id minting
formulation: inv,mkt,ship,ord,org
notes: 'ship.*' = shipment id, but contract text also speaks of organisations owning 'ships' (vessels): name collision with any vessel entity

name: Economy daily tick
formulation: steps production,shipments,spoilage,consumption,prices,advance; day+=1
approximations: contract s9 promises market clearing, labour-market quotes, accounting snapshots in economy.tick: none are tick steps (quotes and accounts are queries; no clearing exists)
notes: CONTRACTS s9 vs code mismatch

name: Inventories (stock ledger)
formulation: adjust(delta): stock+delta, refuse if <0 (tol 1e-9), delete key at <=1e-9
invariants: stock never negative (E1); moves conserve units
approximations: epsilon 1e-9 silently zeroes tiny stock; weight/volume/capacity not enforced; stock is real-valued
notes: Inventory owner: Economy mints inv.*; settlement Business.inventory stores string. Project.account doubles as inventory ref (ownership conflict)

name: Recipe and good catalogue
formulation: data only (no formula)
approximations: no technology/knowledge gating logic; skill band stored opaque; weight stored but unused; recipe quantities not yet supplied for pirate data
notes: Good.type open (Rex GOODS.md Open 1-8). PLATFORM mission wants every production method; here only a data container

name: Recipe rates provider
formulation: rates(recipe)->{unitsPerFixtureDay,labourPerUnit}; read each tick, finite >=0
approximations: two scalars stand for all production physics (kiln time, labour intensity)
notes: Rates interface declared in both repos (structural duplicate type). contract.material_provider.rates

name: Material availability
formulation: min over inputs of stock/qty; inputsAny group pools options' stock / group.units; Infinity if no inputs
approximations: ignores equipment and labour (settlement's side)

name: Recipe execution (consume inputs, yield outputs)
formulation: consume inputs*units; inputsAny drawn first-available in option order; add yield*units output; add byproduct*units; producedToday += outputs
approximations: no mass/energy balance (realism chemistry unused); yields are data
notes: Same 'production' as settlement.production.constraint_Q split by contract: settlement decides Q, economy executes it

name: MaterialProvider (settlement asks, economy implements)
home: Toolchain/settlement/src/providers.ts MaterialProvider; Toolchain/economy/src/material.ts materialProvider(runner); CONTRACTS.md s4a
formulation: interface: available/produce/have/take/rates; economy implements over a Runner so calls are logged
approximations: settlement stub floors available; economy returns fractional
tests: engine.test E2, U6, U13; pirate I1
notes: contract.material_provider. Implemented by: economy (host wires it). Consumed by: settlement production and projects. Day counters separate

name: Abstract-market production
formulation: for mode 'abstract': stock += productionPerDay each tick
approximations: production independent of labour, inputs, season, capital; constant per day
notes: DUPLICATE purpose of settlement production Q (stock creation); exclusive only by market mode flag

name: Production roll-up
formulation: at tick producedLast=producedToday; producedToday=0
approximations: contract says Economy reads Settlement's production(biz,day) via the reader; code instead counts through its own produce command, reader.production unused
notes: Same datum in two records: settlement DayProduction.lines[].q (per line, latest day) and economy producedLast (per good)

name: Market five numbers
formulation: data record; null = open, never defaulted
approximations: per-market scalar constants; no dynamics for base price
notes: Rex's five numbers are static data; nothing updates basePrice or targetReserve from history

name: Spoilage / decay of goods
formulation: lost = units * spoilagePerDay (exponential, constant rate) in every inventory and in transit; null rate = no spoilage
sources: GOODS.md data 'marked estimate where it is'
approximations: constant fraction: no temperature/humidity/packaging/age; one rate per good
notes: OVERLAP with settlement.building.condition_decay (both constant daily loss) and with realism decay. CONTRACTS s8 lists spoilage in accounting; accounts() has no spoilage field. Spoilage produces no waste (E16 planned)

name: Market consumption
formulation: taken=min(demand,stock); unmet=demand-taken
sources: Rex five numbers; perCapita awaits realism
approximations: demand fixed (not price- or income-elastic); free: no money moves, households have no budget; unmet demand has no feedback (no starvation, migration)
notes: Contract s5/s6 say household income drives consumption; not built. Needs belong to realism/POPULATION (PLAN step 11, I3)

name: Shortage detection
formulation: shortage = 1 - stock/targetReserve (event unclamped, query clamped to [0,1])
notes: Computed twice: tick consumption() (unclamped, local) and queries.shortage() (clamped)

name: Price rule
home: Toolchain/economy/src/queries.ts price(); config PriceRule; tick prices()
formulation: default 'base': price=basePrice; 'shortage-linear': base*(low+(high-low)*shortage) (0.7..3 illustrative, NOT adopted)
sources: ALIGNMENT s10 illustration (not adopted); RESEARCH s1 proposes king-davenant
approximations: default price never moves; no supply/demand clearing; no arbitrage dynamics except the example policy
notes: Blocked by contract s12.5 (Rex: price formula)

name: King-Davenant price curve (researched, unbuilt)
formulation: f(s)=0.824/(0.88-s)^2 (Jevons fit to King-Davenant 1699 table); floor 0.7, cap 5.5 proposed
approximations: corn-harvest deficit mapped onto market stock shortage; surplus side is an estimate; period-specific (17th c. England)
notes: Mixed: universality of the curve not established. Awaiting Rex approval

name: Buy/sell at market price

outputs.name: stock moved between holder inventory and market stall

formulation: amount=unit*units; unit=given ?? priceOf(...); money via LedgerProvider; goods move holder<->stall; refused if no price or beyond stock
approximations: buyer balance not checked (debt allowed); no spread, no price impact of trade size (price changes only at tick), no fees/duties; counterparty is the market id as a ledger holder
notes: No market clearing or matching: trades are host commands at a given price. Duty/tax is only a ledger kind string, not implemented

name: Shipments over host map
formulation: arrives=state.day+days; leaves source now; tick lands when arrives<=day; spoilage applies in transit
approximations: days from host map (integer not enforced); no weather, loss, capacity, vessel entity; freight is a host number
notes: Transport is a data-only coupling; no distance/speed/vehicle mechanics (realism mechanics unused)

name: Organisations
formulation: record only (inventories list never filled by code)
approximations: no behaviour; companies are driven by the example script only
notes: Domain E/F organisations minimal

name: Labour-market wage quote
formulation: posted-median: median wage of role's posts; ratio: median*clamp(1+e*(posts-workers)/max(posts,workers,1), floor, ceiling) (illustrative)
sources: CONTRACTS s5; ratio rule 'illustrative, NOT Rex's'
approximations: quote is a median of posted wages: no search, bargaining, unemployment, reservation wage
notes: OVERLAP with settlement wage (fixed). Quote cannot affect anything unless the host calls setWage (contract s12.6, Q10). Role strings must match across engines

name: Accounting view

inputs.name: ledger rows for holder in day range

formulation: profit=(revenue+otherIn)-(purchases+wages+rent+freight+otherOut); inventoryValue = sum price*units; self-rows ignored
approximations: cost of goods (inputs consumed at cost) and spoilage lines promised in CONTRACTS s8 are NOT in accounts(); inventory at market not cost; no depreciation; cash-basis
notes: Contract s8 vs code mismatch

name: LedgerProvider (economy asks, settlement implements)
home: Toolchain/economy/src/providers.ts LedgerProvider, StubLedger; Toolchain/settlement/src/commands.ts payCommand, queries.ts ledger/balanceOf
formulation: balance(holder); transfer(from,to,amount,kind,subject,note)->id; rows(holder,fromDay,toDay)
invariants: money moves only through this interface; conserved
approximations: economy StubLedger.day is set manually by host: ledger day coupled to host clock
notes: contract.ledger_provider. Implemented by: host over settlement pay/balanceOf/ledger. Consumed by: economy. LedgerRow == settlement Transaction (structural duplicate)

name: SettlementReader (settlement -> economy)
formulation: host builds read-only view over SettlementState each day
invariants: production only valid same day (latest day kept)
approximations: only posts() is read by economy src (labour.ts); businesses/production/hasFixture unused
notes: contract.settlement_reader. Implemented by: host adapter over settlement state. Consumed by: economy labour. Three of four methods have no consumer in code

name: PriceProvider (valueOf)
formulation: valueOf(subject,day)
approximations: declared; nothing calls it; economy src has no implementation of it; valuation of land/buildings unowned
notes: contract.price_provider: would be implemented by economy, consumed by settlement.sell for unpriced sale; blocked by CONTRACTS s12.3

name: LabourSupplyProvider (population -> economy)
formulation: supply(market,role,day)->number|null
approximations: stub only; no population model exists
notes: contract.labour_supply_provider: implemented by host/population (none), consumed by economy. Overlaps settlement LabourProvider.draw

name: PopulationProvider.headcount
formulation: headcount(market,day)
approximations: stub only; PLAN step 11 waits on body-and-world keeper
notes: contract.population_provider: implemented by host (none yet); consumed by economy consumption

name: TransportProvider.days
formulation: days(from,to)->number (Infinity unreachable)
approximations: stub only; host map not integrated
notes: contract.transport_provider: implemented by host (map); consumed by economy ship

name: Order-of-a-day contract
formulation: settlement.tick(day N) -> economy.tick(N); economy reads production(biz,N) same day
approximations: day unit shared but counters separate; economy tick command takes no day
tests: pirate I2 (30-day benchmark, in pirate repo, not read)

name: Inventory ownership split
formulation: economy mints inv.*, settlement stores opaque string; Project.account passed as inventory ref
notes: CONFLICT: settlement tick/projects.ts passes Project.account (a holder id) to MaterialProvider.have/take as an inventory id, while economy keys inventories by inv.* with a separate holder field

name: Three-ports policy example
formulation: example policy: buy at surplus port, ship to worst-shortage port if price higher; uses shortage-linear 0.7..3 (illustrative)
approximations: example only, not an engine rule; 'port.north' etc are placeholders
notes: Port names appear only in the example; src/ has no pirate-specific text

name: Burial and waste flows
formulation: coffins, burial labour, refuse/night-soil as negative-price goods carried away for a fee
notes: Blocked on CULTURE.md burial customs and realism sanitation. Overlaps settlement scope (cemeteries/sanitation/land use, PACKAGES s8, Q16-18)

name: Cemeteries, sanitation, land use
formulation: parcel kind cemetery with grave capacity, sanitation fixtures, parcel land use
approximations: sketch only
notes: Q16,Q17,Q18 open; period facts for a c.1700 Caribbean port are pirate-specific research. Overlaps economy burial_waste and realism sanitation
